learning_outcomes.text: Learns the navigation method and tool appropriate for the nature of the work.
Learns the communication and data infrastructure, and measurement methods in kinematic positioning.
Understands how to integrate navigation products into GIS.
Understands how to acquire knowledge about special topics in navigation.
Learns the general theory of CORS.
Understands CORS VRS and FKP methods in field applications. Learns the navigation method and tool appropriate for the nature of the work.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to navigation and kinematic positioning.
GNSS introduction, GPS/GNSS receiver-antenna types and characteristics used for navigation of land, sea and air vehicles.
Global, regional and augmentation satellite systems with Multi-GNSS concept.
Absolute position determination methods (SPP, PPP and RT-PPP).
Differential (relative) position determination methods (DGNSS and RTK).
Network-RTK correction methods (VRS, FKP, MAC etc.).
Mechanisms for real-time GNSS data transfer and international standards.
Personal navigation applications with mobile devices (mobile phones, PDAs, etc.).
Integration of electronic maps and navigation systems.
Assisted GPS (A-GPS) and LBS (Location Based Services) and their applications.
INS and IMU applications, mobile mapping systems.
SLAM algorithms, indoor positioning and navigation systems.
